newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China '97 GDP growth seen at 11-12 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China '97 GDP growth seen at 11-12 pct.

text.p: China's gross domestic product (GDP) growth is forecast to be 11-12 percent in 1997, the Economic Information Daily said on Tuesday.
Economic growth this year has great potential because many projects that received investment in 1992 and 1993 are going on line in 1996 and 1997, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
China's economic growth in 1996 was 9.7 percent.
